observed_defect: Flat prairie lacks dynamic terrain silhouette for strategic camera
design_intent: Create asymmetric rolling hills and valleys for visual depth and buildable meadow visibility
expected_visual_difference: Gentle, organic terrain undulations with clear valley and hill contours
mobile_risks: No excessive polygons or complex modifiers; keep mesh under 20K vertices

actions.reason: Shape broad asymmetric rolling hills and valleys using sculpt tool to preserve existing geometry while adding organic terrain undulations; avoid over-detailing
Create visible valley contour by insetting a narrow edge along the lowest terrain point to enhance strategic visibility and define buildable meadow boundaries
Softly bevel hill edges to avoid harsh geometry and maintain mobile performance; preserve contact with city pad and outer border
